sql:
SELECT e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID AND l.Date = e.`Examination Date`
WHERE l.IGM <= 40 OR l.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY e.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
